scope: Official AOSP Android 17, synthetic SIMHub OMAPI reader/profile with redaction enforced by the real Android subscription APIs. The actual native thread and new-message forms both handed a reserved draft to the explicitly selected cross-process messaging fixture only after tapping the action. The target app had no privileged phone-state permission, and zero SMS or RCS messages were sent to a carrier. Test observer waits and AVD responsiveness settings were extended for software-only rendering.
